messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Silversky PO ingestion failed. Vendor uploaded an executed PO but signatory block: the signatory lists a third-party reseller instead of an authorized Silversky officer. Portal says signature_authority_mismatch. We have a webinar and a co-marketing tweet scheduled for Thu. Can Legal advise shortcut? @Nora
Ibrahim (Procurement): Portal enforces signatory authority. Our policy requires either: (A) a corrected PO signed by an officer on file or (B) a notarized power of attorney tying the reseller signature to Silversky authority. No provisional accepts for signature mismatch without Legal/Procurement signoff.
marketplace-bot: ingestion -> REJECTED: {"ticket":"MP-102334","reason":"signature_authority_mismatch","expected_signer":"Silversky Inc - CFO or CEO","received_signer":"BrightResell LLC - Sales Dir"}
Pri (CSM): Silversky says their channel team accidentally routed signature to reseller. They can get the CFO to e-sign but earliest is next Monday (CFO traveling). They offered an internal authorization email from their GC.
Nora (Legal): An internal email from GC is not sufficient for contract execution in our policy. Quick options: 1) expedited e-sign by CFO in DocuSign (best), 2) a signed Board resolution or PO amendment signed by an authorized officer, 3) limited power-of-attorney notarized. I can prepare a PO amendment template that calls out the correct signatory and a warranty of authority; if vendor can e-sign that within 48 hours, Procurement may provisionally accept. This is still an exception.
Devin (Finance): Payments teams need the legal signer on record for invoice mapping. I can create a provisional ledger code `PROV-SILV-2026` to allow a "soft enable" but I won't release funds until we have a valid signer on file. If Legal approves provisional mapping window, I will set payment_hold flag and manual review.
Zoe (Sales): Our joint webinar is on Thursday 11am PT and the social announcement is scheduled Thu morning. If we can't enable by Wed EOD, Marketing will pull the tweet and webinar co-present. Can Partnerships push AE/channel lead to prioritize CFO signature?
Silversky AE: Looping in Silversky channel lead and ops. They committed to escalate to CFO but warned it might take until Monday. Asking if a notarized PO with reseller signature plus a GC letter would be acceptable in interim.
Nora (Legal): Notarized reseller signature + GC letter is higher risk; procurement typically rejects that for signature_authority_mismatch. However, we can accept a notarized PO + GC letter only if it includes an express ratification clause from Silversky's authorized officer within 3 business days. I'll draft a short ratification addendum template and DocuSign link.
Ibrahim (Procurement): If Legal posts ratification addendum and vendor signs via DocuSign, Procurement can mark ticket MP-102334 as PROVISIONAL_ACCEPT for 3 business days. After ratification attached, Ops can flip integration toggle to "enabled_provisional". No billing or payouts until Finance clears.
Pri (CSM): Pushed to vendor ops and channel lead. They said DocuSign ratification is possible if we send template now. AE says they'll try to get GC to sign within 24 hours, CFO to follow up.
Devin (Finance): I will create PROV-SILV-2026 as hold-only and set payment_release = false. Notify me when ratification addendum is attached.
Maya (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Nora to post ratification addendum template in MP-102334, 2) Pri to get DocuSign signed QA by vendor, 3) Ibrahim to set portal PROVISIONAL_ACCEPT on attach, 4) Devin to create provisional ledger. If ratification not attached within 24h we'll need to postpone webinar/social.
marketplace-bot: ticket update -> MP-102334 status: PENDING_RATIFICATION.
Zoe (Sales): I'll prep a webinar contingency plan and let Marketing know to hold tweet until we have green.
Silversky AE: Sending DocuSign instructions to Silversky ops now. Will update within 6-12 hours.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll monitor MP-102334 and ping legal/procurement if anything slips. :raised_hands:
